issues.title: Login bootstrap 401s (me/refresh)
issues.why: Before credentials, UI calls GET /api/auth/me and POST /api/auth/refresh producing 401 UNAUTHORIZED / REFRESH_TOKEN_MISSING noise.
issues.how: Skip me/refresh on public auth routes, or treat expected anonymous 401 as silent.

issues.title: Permissions nav visible to HR_ADMIN
issues.why: HR sees Permissions; page shows Access restricted (Super Admins only). Dead-end nav.
issues.how: Hide Permissions unless memberType === 'SUPER_ADMIN'; keep Access Restricted for deep links.

issues.title: SA-only Settings deep-links show Access restricted
issues.why: SettingsNav hides these for HR, but hard navigation shows Access restricted instead of redirecting to first allowed panel.
issues.how: On unauthorized settings slug, redirect via firstAccessibleSettingsPath(role).

issues.title: Reports secondary nav not real hrefs
issues.why: No <a href="/reports/..."> discovered; report switches are not shareable links
issues.how: Use Next <Link href="/reports/<slug>"> for each report item

issues.title: Reports path /reports/workforce/headcount intermittent Next 404
issues.why: Hard goto /reports/workforce/headcount returned Next.js HTML 404 during export-retry (not API JSON). Report shell otherwise worked in pass1 for all 15 types.
